name: Recurrente

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED — Svix standard. Headers `svix-id`, `svix-timestamp`, `svix-signature`. Algorithm HMAC-SHA256 over `{svix_id}.{svix_timestamp}.{raw_body}`, secret prefixed `whsec_` and base64-decoded before use. Timestamp covered; use a 300s tolerance plus svix-id dedup. The official `svix` npm/PyPI package verifies this directly. Events include intent.succeeded, intent.pending, intent.failed, intent.canceled, intent.paid, plus subscription, setup-intent, refund and dispute events.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Headers `X-PUBLIC-KEY` and `X-SECRET-KEY`. Test keys are distinguished by account/environment rather than a documented literal prefix — do not fabricate a `sk_test_` regex. Webhook secret is separately prefixed `whsec_` (Svix convention).

notes: A modern, developer-first subscription gateway built for Central America, where regions.json currently has zero providers and falls back to a 5% MoR. It is also the only provider in this cluster that uses Svix — meaning PagoKit can reuse an off-the-shelf, well-tested verifier instead of hand-rolling one.
SDKs: No official first-party server SDK verified, but webhook verification is solved by the official `svix` library. REST API is clean and well documented.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Best-in-class for GT/SV/HN subscription SaaS. Overlaps dlocal_go and placetopay in Central America but is the only one purpose-built for recurring billing there.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
